destinations.name: Serengeti National Park
destinations.subtitle: Endless Plains & The Great Wildebeest Migration
destinations.description: Vast plains, extraordinary wildlife and some of Africa's most unforgettable natural spectacles. Serengeti is the crown jewel of African wilderness, hosting over two million wildebeest and zebras on their eternal migration journey.
wildlife_highlights: Big Five (Lion, Leopard, Elephant, Buffalo, Rhino)

destinations.name: Ngorongoro Crater
destinations.subtitle: The Eighth Wonder of the World & Wildlife Sanctuary
destinations.description: Descend into one of Africa's most remarkable wildlife destinations, where dramatic landscapes surround an extraordinary concentration of wildlife. A pristine 600m deep volcanic caldera housing over 25,000 large animals.
wildlife_highlights: Thousands of pink flamingos on Lake Magadi
destinations.best_time: Excellent year-round; dry season (June-October) has easiest wildlife viewing

destinations.name: Tarangire National Park
destinations.subtitle: Land of Giants, Ancient Baobabs & Elephant Herds
destinations.description: Known for its magnificent elephants, ancient baobabs and distinctive landscapes, Tarangire offers a quieter and deeply rewarding safari experience along the scenic Tarangire River.
destinations.best_time: July to October (Dry season river congregation)

destinations.name: Lake Manyara National Park
destinations.subtitle: Rift Valley Jewel & Tree-Climbing Lions
destinations.description: A compact and diverse ecosystem where forests, wetlands, open plains and wildlife come together beneath the dramatic Rift Valley landscape, famous for tree-climbing lions and flamingo flocks.
destinations.best_time: Dry season (June-October) for mammals; Wet season (November-May) for flamingos and birds

destinations.name: Mount Kilimanjaro
destinations.subtitle: Roof of Africa & Highest Free-Standing Mountain
destinations.description: Experience the presence of Africa's highest mountain (5,895m), whether as the centerpiece of your journey with a summit expedition or as part of a scenic wider Tanzanian adventure.
destinations.best_time: January-March and June-October (clearest skies and warmest conditions)
destinations.recommended_duration: 6 - 8 Days for summit; 1 Day for scenic foothills hike

destinations.name: Zanzibar Archipelago
destinations.subtitle: Turquoise Waters, Spice Island & Stone Town Heritage
destinations.description: Complete your African journey with warm Indian Ocean waters, rich history, beautiful beaches and the distinctive character of Zanzibar. The perfect bush-to-beach finale.
wildlife_highlights: Red Colobus Monkeys in Jozani Forest
destinations.best_time: June to October and December to February (dry and sunny beach weather)

packages.title: 7-Day Northern Circuit Signature Safari
packages.subtitle: Tarangire, Lake Manyara, Serengeti Plains & Ngorongoro Crater
packages.overview: Our premier, most celebrated Tanzanian safari. Experience the full spectrum of Northern Tanzania's wildlife ecosystems: the elephant-rich woodlands of Tarangire, the rift valley waters of Manyara, three glorious days on the boundless Serengeti plains, culminating in an awe-inspiring descent into the Ngorongoro Crater.
highlights: Complete exploration of all 4 Northern Circuit national parks
3 nights in the Serengeti tracking Big Cats and the Great Migration
Crater floor descent for rare Black Rhino sightings
Encounter thousands of elephants in Tarangire National Park
Private customized 4x4 Land Cruiser with pop-up photography roof

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park
itinerary.desc: Morning pickup from your Arusha hotel or Kilimanjaro Airport. Scenic drive to Tarangire National Park, famous for its majestic baobabs and gigantic elephant herds. Enjoy an afternoon game drive along the Tarangire River. Dinner and overnight at Maramboi Tented Camp.

itinerary.title: Tarangire to Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.desc: Morning departure to Lake Manyara beneath the Great Rift Valley escarpment. Spot tree-climbing lions, troops of olive baboons, and thousands of flamingos. Overnight at Lake Manyara Serena Lodge overlooking the rift valley.

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara to Central Serengeti (Seronera)
itinerary.desc: Ascend the highlands and traverse the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, descending onto the endless savannah of the Serengeti. Afternoon game drive in the Seronera Valley tracking leopards and cheetahs. Overnight at Serengeti Safari Camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day Serengeti Wilderness & Big Cats
itinerary.desc: Sunrise morning game drive when predators are most active. Return to camp for bush brunch, followed by afternoon exploration of river loops and kopjes. Sunset over the savannah. Overnight at Serengeti Safari Camp.

itinerary.title: Serengeti Migration Tracking to Ngorongoro Rim
itinerary.desc: Early morning game drive capturing wildlife in golden light. Travel through wildlife corridors towards the crater rim with a cultural stop option at a Maasai community. Overnight at Ngorongoro Serena Safari Lodge on the rim.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Floor Safari
itinerary.desc: Dawn descent 600 meters into the crater floor for an unforgettable 6-hour game drive. Spot the Big Five in a single morning, including endangered black rhinos and massive lions. Afternoon drive to Karatu. Overnight at Farm House Valley.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Arusha / Kilimanjaro Airport
itinerary.desc: Leisurely breakfast surrounded by coffee plantations. Optional stop at a local cultural market before private transfer to Arusha or JRO Airport for your departure flight or Zanzibar connection.

included: All national park entrance, conservation, and crater service fees

faqs.question: How do I book a safari with Malunda Explorers?
faqs.answer: Booking is simple and transparent. You can choose any of our featured safari packages or use our interactive booking system to configure your dates, travelers, and accommodation. Once you submit, you receive an immediate booking reference (e.g., ME-2026-0001) and our safari director confirms availability within a few hours. To lock in lodge bookings, a 30% deposit is payable online or via wire transfer.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay a deposit?
faqs.answer: Yes. A 30% deposit is required at the time of confirmation to secure high-demand national park permits, luxury tented camp rooms, and private 4x4 vehicles. The remaining balance of 70% is due 30 days prior to your safari start date, or upon arrival in Arusha by prior arrangement.

faqs.question: What payment methods are available?
faqs.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express) via secure encrypted gateway, international direct bank wire transfers in USD or EUR to our CRDB Bank account in Arusha, and East African mobile money (M-Pesa, Airtel Money).

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Cancellations made more than 60 days before safari departure receive a 90% refund of total deposits (10% retained for unrecoverable park and administrative costs). Cancellations between 30 and 59 days receive a 50% refund. Cancellations under 30 days are non-refundable as lodges have locked in bookings, though we always assist in rescheduling where possible.

faqs.question: Can I customize my safari itinerary?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Tailor-made journeys are our specialty. You can adjust the number of days, swap destinations, alter accommodation tiers (budget, mid-range, or 5-star luxury), and add extensions like Zanzibar or Mount Kilimanjaro.

faqs.question: What is included in a Malunda Explorers safari?
faqs.answer: Our safaris are all-inclusive on the ground: all Tanzania National Park entrance fees, conservation fees, concession fees, crater service permits, private 4x4 Land Cruiser with pop-up roof and English-speaking guide, all meals (breakfast, lunch/picnic, dinner), unlimited chilled bottled water in the vehicle, all lodge accommodations, and AMREF Flying Doctors emergency medical evacuation insurance.

faqs.question: What is not included in the safari price?
faqs.answer: International airfare to Tanzania, Tanzania entry visa fees ($50 for most nationalities, $100 for US citizens), personal travel and health insurance, alcoholic beverages and personal laundry at lodges (unless booked under Ultra-Luxury tier), gratuities for your guide and lodge staff, and optional activities like hot air balloon rides.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Tanzania for a safari?
faqs.answer: Tanzania is a premier year-round safari destination. The dry season from late June to October offers prime wildlife viewing around water sources and river crossings of the Great Migration. January to March is fantastic in the southern Serengeti for the wildebeest calving season with high predator action. The short rains in November-December and long rains in April-May offer lush emerald scenery and fewer crowds.

faqs.question: Is Tanzania suitable for family safaris with children?
faqs.answer: Yes, Tanzania is exceptionally warm and welcoming to families. We recommend children be 5 years or older to comfortably enjoy game drives. Our family safaris feature interconnected rooms, swimming pools, flexible schedules, and engaging cultural activities like archery with the Hadzabe.

faqs.question: Can you arrange airport transfers and Zanzibar extensions?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle seamless transfers between Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO), Arusha Airport (ARK), and local hotels. We also organize domestic bush flights directly from Serengeti airstrips to Zanzibar for stress-free bush-to-beach vacations.

faqs.question: What happens after I book?
faqs.answer: Immediately after submitting your booking, you receive a confirmation email with your booking reference. Within 12-24 hours, our safari operations team sends you a personalized welcome pack containing your day-by-day itinerary, lodge confirmations, Tanzania packing list, visa advice, and direct WhatsApp contact with your dedicated safari coordinator.
